subject: Literature
title: Russian Literature's Golden Age
description: A quick win: understand Russian Literature's Golden Age.

hook.text: In the nineteenth century, Russia produced a burst of literary genius unmatched by any other nation.

buildup.text: Tolstoy, Dostoevsky, Chekhov, and Turgenev explored the depths of morality, faith, and the human soul.

discovery.text: Dostoevsky's Crime and Punishment pioneered the psychological novel by entering a murderer's tormented mind.

twist.text: Dostoevsky wrote many masterpieces under crushing gambling debts, sometimes finishing chapters hours before deadlines.

climax.text: Russian literature showed the world that fiction could probe moral and spiritual questions as deeply as philosophy.

punchline.text: Russia's novelists became the world's philosophers.

quiz.question: What literary innovation is Dostoevsky credited with?
